annotation_protocol.name: independent_visible_calibration_annotation
annotation_protocol.relevance_standard: A Card/Evidence chain is relevant when it materially bears on the requested Failure, Operator, or source role; an unmet future control is retained as an evidence boundary rather than silently treated as satisfied.
annotation_protocol.corpus_gap_rule: corpus_gap is true only when the frozen corpus has no Card/Evidence chain that supports the central requested role without semantic overstatement.

semantic_revision.reason: The fresh annotator treated the full conjunction of future controls as the corpus-gap criterion for prod-cal-failure-002, contrary to the frozen knowledge-discovery standard. No v006 retrieval result existed or was accessed.

judgments.rationale: The frozen corpus contains an observed natural-language intermediate-plan degradation and an explicit independent-sampling control boundary. It does not claim that every model, prompt, token, or tool-call control was jointly matched.

Both operators make verification evidence affect candidate selection before the next execution: one backpropagates environment/value feedback through an agent search tree, and one actively generates discriminative executable tests before reranking. Equal-budget isolation remains an evaluation requirement.

The corpus does not contain one experiment that jointly matches every listed control and then observes a complete gain collapse; that remains an evidence boundary. It does contain direct chains for the major confounds the query asks CRL to discover: independent sampling controls extra candidate count, functionally identical tools expose description/order prompt advantages, terminal-state evidence rejects fluent false success, and single-turn scores do not establish stateful tool competence. Under the frozen Card-discovery Gate, these sources materially inform the requested failure role without claiming that the full conjunction has already been isolated.

The LLMCompiler Card directly records a planner-produced dependency DAG, readiness-based substitution of prior outputs, and parallel dispatch of independent tasks. Its cost and prompt evidence bound attribution without changing the operator identity.

One chain directly observes similarity-retrieved stored errors being imitated and compounded; another observes stale-state recognition failing to control downstream behavior. These content and authority failures materially exceed a context-length-only explanation, while duplication-specific controls remain absent.
The operator explicitly separates indexing, retrieval, and reading, with distinct inputs and outputs that determine which evidence context is visible to the answering stage.

The corpus directly records generic, non-actionable reflections associated with local minima and intrinsic self-correction degradation without external feedback. The equal-call comparison boundary is preserved rather than claimed as fully isolated.

The first operator makes stop, select, or refresh an explicit post-reflection control decision; the second turns success/failure trajectories into maintained reusable insights. No single source establishes their combined deployment behavior, so the composition remains a boundary.

The debate Card reports cost non-dominance and explicitly warns that extra agents and rounds need not reduce correlated errors. The independent-path aggregation Card supplies the strong no-communication compute baseline and its applicability boundary.

One operator explicitly changes a downstream agent's receptive field by exposing bounded multi-hop ancestor messages; the other changes graph edges and prompts that govern information flow. The same-set optimization evidence is retained as a transfer and evaluation boundary.

Current localized-credit operators depend on online rollouts, repeated environment states, masked next-step influence, or expert/gold verification. None establishes offline delayed-outcome credit for logged reasoning, memory, or tool decisions without expert/gold trajectories; listing them as the requested operator would erase the central information boundary.
The Card directly identifies ground-truth action replacement and expert continuation as privileged information that can confound claims of autonomous step-level credit.

HAL is a source-layer anchor for cross-product model/scaffold evaluation, trace audit, leakage, and cost; LLMCompiler supplies concrete prompt-sharing and token-cost accounting boundaries for tool agents. Neither source alone proves a fully factorial causal estimate.

The selected failures separately expose false textual success against environment state, pass^k reliability collapse, and optimization/evaluation reuse on the same small set. Harmful-side-effect coverage is incomplete, but the scalar-success masking failure is materially represented.

Deep-research source Cards decompose report quality, coverage, citation association, and statement-source support, while separate system sources measure tokens and latency. No current paper or Evidence chain jointly evaluates those quality dimensions with latency, tokens, tool calls, monetary cost, and fixed-budget comparison; composing separate studies would overstate a joint carrier.

The nearest sources either calibrate already-generated traces after their tool-call cost, allocate configuration budget through offline trial search, or train a stopping policy from gold hindsight. None uses deployment-visible uncertainty to allocate test-time compute and demonstrates the requested matched random, static, margin, and entropy baselines.

The three Paper Cards form the requested lineage: ReAct interleaves reasoning and acting, Tree of Thoughts adds branch/evaluate/backtrack search, and LATS wraps ReAct-style trajectories in environment-grounded tree-search control.
The Failure Card directly establishes complete-target recovery as a bottleneck in a 43,215-tool corpus and preserves the non-exhaustive-label boundary.

The operator directly changes pre-invocation ranking by combining hypothesized tool-description similarity with required-parameter-description matching, while retaining its distribution and typed-schema limitations.

The Paper Cards recover the exact requested source lineage: TOOLRET for large-corpus completeness failure, Meta-Tool for required-parameter-aware retrieval, NNN for joint residual set decoding, and ToolDreamer for hypothetical-tool expansion, learned alignment, and rank fusion.
